verdictRationale: Most of the decided behavior is implemented faithfully and verified by execution: A1-A3 (Q01, Q02), E1 (Q03), the rung operations R0-R3, every speed sequence, D49 on every rung, the load reference within 28 days, the window wait and window-end check, persistence, the warning-sign instrument, Situation 2 (MODERATE floor, holds, restrictions, triggers), Situation 3 coherence (C-Q08-1, C-Q08-2), every lever (Q09-Q11) and the interaction rules with a byte-identical default path (Q12). One BLOCKING finding remains: a report made while an episode is open applies neither the new condition's sport coverage nor its intent ceiling, so a person who reports a mild illness can keep normal training in one sport, with progression, or near-normal doses for two weeks (Q05, B4). Six MAJOR findings affect Situation 1 and E2: R4 re-establishes strength and drops the held reference from 29 days after the last pre-window session; a declared break after a rest window is read as SHORT; an unreviewed ladder week passes on the projection (calendar-only); a ladder that crosses a race keeps race effort in a reduced rung and imposes pre-race doses after it; an early recovery has no exit before the chosen end (a B6 gap) and lighter re-reports are read as persistence; a short race result caps the stated running exposure for weeks.

interpretations.rationale: Waiting rest after the window until the structured check is C-Q05-1. The waiting days must also count as days without the sport for a later break (SSCTR-V1CPI-03) and an early check must be possible (SSCTR-V1CPI-06).
A partial week cannot be the whole executed week the transitionRule requires; repeating the rung in the next whole week is the conservative reading (S1-5: R2, R2, R3, R4).

R4 is the held dose with no step that week; the step happens between an executed R4 and R5. When D49 caps R4 below the held sets, R5 can combine the last set with a step (O-2): consistent with D49 and the R6 regain rule; disclose it.
A reduced window not executed as planned repeats its own rung (the transitionRule); none done reads as rest (C-Q05-5). Conservative.

Reading 'reported again at the next weekly review' as a chained report of the same condition in a later plan week is stricter than the text and acceptable, provided an improving athlete has another way out: today a lighter re-report twice routes to the clinical hold (SSCTR-V1CPI-06). The weekly re-ask of every sign is C-Q05-4.
interpretations.condition: Depends on SSCTR-V1CPI-06 (early check; a lighter-intent re-report is not counted as persistence).

interpretations.rationale: One episode at a time is a V1 limitation for a local report in a non-overlapping scope: the athlete can skip or rest without debt, and the existing local-fatigue and substitution paths remain. It never covers a systemic report, which overlaps by rule and must apply its own coverage (SSCTR-V1CPI-01).
interpretations.condition: Disclose the limitation; keep it out of the systemic case.

interpretations.rationale: The window-end check is the window's end; refusing a change once the return has started keeps the speed from becoming evidence (RC-12).

Without the hold, CONSERVATIVE-LONG would be less conservative than BALANCED-LONG; adding the BALANCED hold to CONSERVATIVE is the coherent reading. For a LONG episode both options are then equal: say so.

interpretations.change: Count the first-step hold in executed weeks: when the entry week is not executed as planned, the hold week moves one week (as the Situation 1 ladder repeats a partial rung), so BALANCED always gives one more executed entry week than the class recipe.

Doses accepted (entry rows for the region, then D49; no first-step hold, which Q07 does not require for a later restriction end). Record the region's own stop and class (from the restriction's start, or the region's last executed exposure), and do not tell the athlete that the first week repeats.

findings.title: A report made while an episode is open applies neither the new condition's sport coverage nor its intent ceiling
findings.item: SSCTR-V1CP-Q05 (approvedRule: affected sports, condition-to-intent availability, window weeks hold; C-Q05-2); Founder B4
findings.kind: (a) undisclosed implementation reading, not among I-01..I-21; (b) decision-internal conflict followed literally
scenarios: (a) p4-chain (a): KNOWN athlete, weeks 0-3 done; W4 Mon MINOR_DISCOMFORT sports [RUN] REDUCE_LIGHT 9 days; W4 Wed MILD_ILLNESS, every warning sign no, REST 5 days -> KEEP 'Your window continues as you chose; nothing else changes'. Strength in W4-W5 is unchanged (back-squat 4x8 at 82.5 kg, then 4x10) and the W4 review gives back-squat and db-bench-press ADVANCE; running keeps R3 with a 50-minute long run.

(b) p4-chain (b): BALANCED return after REDUCE_SUBSTANTIAL MINOR_DISCOMFORT (both sports); MILD_ILLNESS REST reported in the R4 week -> WELLBEING_RUNG_HELD: the week keeps LONG 60 and back-squat 3x10 at 82.5 kg, and the next week repeats R4.
findings.expected: Q05: systemic conditions always affect both programmed sports; MILD_ILLNESS and MILD_INDISPOSITION allow only R2, R1 or R0 (no long run, no near-normal strength volume while unwell); a week holding reduced days holds that sport's gates. B4: never preserve a modality when the information indicates a relevant systemic restriction. A relevant sign (the athlete's own systemic report) is not acted on for one sport: the task contract's ESCALATE_IF.
findings.ruling: Q05's coverage and illness ceiling prevail over the chained-report hold of C-Q05-2, which was written against re-windowing the same or an overlapping condition (RC-06).
findings.minimalCorrection: A systemic report while a local-scope episode is open, or an illness-type report while an affected sport is at R3, R4 or a recipe step, supersedes the open episode from that day (as a declared break or a readiness restart does, I-15) and opens its own window for the sports its condition affects. The 14-day bound on a continuous window counts from the earlier window's start for an overlapping sport (C-Q05-2, last sentence); the instrument, persistence and chaining rules then apply to the new episode. No new number. Every other chained report keeps today's behavior.

scenarios: p5b (a2): REST 5 days FASTER; the window-end check with nothing done; the R3 week (W5) neither reported nor reviewed; W6 Monday review with nothing reported -> KEEP, W6 stays R4 (LONG 60, back-squat 4x8 at 82.5 kg): the held doses after rest without an executed R3.
p5 (a): R2 week silent, R3 week done -> R4 next; reporting the R2 week as not done at the R3 review changes nothing.
findings.context: p5c and p10: without an episode the engine also keeps projected steps after a silent week (the R6 MODERATE return shows step 1 after an unreported entry week). The decision's transitionRule is explicitly stricter for the ladder, and the fixed starts also bypass the QRE-P4-F01 credit reading.
findings.minimalCorrection: Plan a rung's successor only by that week's review: at any later review, an elapsed ladder week of an affected sport without its check counts as not executed and its rung repeats from the current week, with no debt.

findings.title: A ladder that crosses a race keeps race effort in a reduced rung and imposes the pre-race held start after the race
findings.item: SSCTR-V1CP-Q05 (C-Q05-3), Q12 rule 2 (event-phase doses in the envelope); I-17
findings.kind: decision gap at the ladder (C-Q05-3 covers the window only) plus an implementation effect
findings.location: CoachingCore/src/r6-composition.mjs:164 (wellbeingSessions leaves RACE sessions as planned); r6-adaptation.mjs:1203 (RACE_DURING_RETURN disclosure only); :1081 executionOf (a week whose sessions of a sport are all optional never counts as executed)
findings.scenario: p6-race-in-ladder: KNOWN athlete, 10K on 2026-12-26; MILD_ILLNESS REDUCE_SUBSTANTIAL 12-08..12-12, BALANCED: R2 in the taper week; R3 in the race week (touch eased, RACE 75 min kept at race effort); R4 in the post-event week, whose recovery runs are optional (p6b), so the rung repeats; the next-block week then runs R4 from the pre-race held start: EASY 45, EASY 48, LONG 70 against the plan's post-race EASY 30, QUALITY 34, LONG 40.
findings.expected: No race-effort or quality session inside R0-R3 (C-Q05-3); the race is asked, never only disclosed; the envelope's event-phase and next-block rules come last.
findings.minimalCorrection: (1) At the window-end check, a race dated inside an R0-R3 rung or a recipe step of the planned ladder is asked as C-Q05-3 asks for a window; (2) the ladder ends at the race week and never carries the pre-race held start past it; (3) a week with only optional sessions of a sport is not a ladder week for that sport.
findings.owner: SSCTR ruling (this record, I-17) consolidated by the Chief; Engineering; G03 for the question copy

findings.title: Early recovery inside a chosen window has no exit; lighter re-reports are read as persistence
findings.item: Founder B6; SSCTR-V1CP-Q05 (C-Q05-1, C-Q05-2 persistence); I-05
findings.kind: B6 gap (the decision defines no early end; the implementation adds none)
findings.location: CoachingCore/src/v1-f08.mjs:111 (improved refused before the end); r6-adaptation.mjs:1235-1260 (wellbeingCheck: atEnd only); :1215 (a later chained report of the same condition routes clinical)
findings.scenario: p11: MILD_ILLNESS REST 10 days (to 12-16), better on day 3: a check with improved true -> ASK 'outside the options'; a new report with a lighter intent -> KEEP 'Your window continues as you chose'; the same lighter report the next week -> CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED 'You told us again that you are not 100%: seek a professional assessment'. Nothing is planned for 10 days.
findings.expected: B6: no common recovery situation without a legitimate way back. Recovering sooner than the chosen days is common after a mild illness; with the persistence rule (not improved at a short window's end routes clinical), the athlete has a reason to choose long windows and then cannot leave them.
findings.minimalCorrection: Allow the window-end check before the chosen end: every warning sign no and resolved or clearly improved ends the window that day and starts the return (speeds from the window's actual days and rung); 'not improved' before the end changes nothing (persistence applies at the chosen end); a chained report whose intent is lighter than the rung in force is not counted as persistence, and the check is offered instead.
findings.owner: SSCTR ruling (this record) consolidated by the Chief; Engineering; Founder/PCG: whether an early end may fall below the 3-day minimum (RC-16); Founder: B6 judgment

findings.title: A short race result caps the stated running exposure for weeks
findings.kind: implementation follows one clause literally ('used exactly as a reported longest run ... single-run ceiling reference') against the decision's other clauses
findings.scenario: p13-short-races, INTERMEDIATE, 150 min / 3 days, no longest run reported: no race -> W0 EASY 45, 45, LONG 45 (135); 5K in 25 min -> W0 and W1 EASY 25, 25, LONG 25 (75), W2 80; the Founder athlete's 5K in 30.6 min -> 90; 3K in 12 min -> W0 EASY 12, 12, LONG 15 (39; runs below run.minimumSessionMinutes 15); 10K in 48 min -> unchanged.
findings.expected: Q04: the race never enters weekly minutes or days, and its decided effect is a week-1 redistribution inside availability; R6: no continuous run below run.minimumSessionMinutes (QRE-R6-09). A race of D minutes shows the longest recent run is at least D (a lower bound), not at most D.
findings.minimalCorrection: Use the race only as a lower bound: it may raise the week-1 long-run cap within availability and the long-run share, never lower a session or the single-run ceiling below what the intake gives without it, and never below run.minimumSessionMinutes; otherwise it is history only (the decision's own fallback).
findings.owner: Engineering (rule stated in this record); a fresh SSCTR recheck

findings.title: The BALANCED first-step hold of a readiness restart is absorbed when the entry week is partly done
findings.item: SSCTR-V1CP-Q07 ('first step held one more executed week'); I-09
findings.location: CoachingCore/src/r6-adaptation.mjs:1404-1406 (RETURN_HOLD REPEAT placed at fromWeek + 1 whatever the entry week's execution)
findings.scenario: p7(a): clinical break in W3, declaration W4 Tue; skipping one run of the entry week gives the same sequence (entry, entry, step 1) as the fully executed case: one executed entry week before step 1, as the class recipe alone.
findings.minimalCorrection: Count the hold in executed weeks (I-09 MODIFY).

findings.title: A restriction's end: the record and the reason misstate the region's lapse and the hold
findings.kind: record and explanation defect; doses faithful
findings.location: CoachingCore/src/r6-adaptation.mjs:1392 (firstDayWithout reads any strength session), :1415 (reason appends 'its first week repeated once')
findings.scenario: p7(b): AVOID_LOWER_BODY_STRENGTH for weeks 4-8, ended in week 9 -> 'strength restarts after 2 days without it, with a lighter entry and 2 conditional steps back, its first week repeated once', while the lower rows had about five weeks without exposure and no hold is applied (entry 1x8 at RIR 4, then 2 sets).
findings.minimalCorrection: Record the region's own stop and class; state no hold for a region restart.

findings.title: Elliptical self-inclusion across a clause boundary resolves to NONCLINICAL on a structured no
findings.scenario: p9 with category FAMILY: 'my mother had covid; me too', 'my mother had covid. I did too', 'meu pai ficou doente, eu tambem', 'mi mama tuvo covid, yo tambien' are CLINICAL on FREEZE-6, ASK on the candidate, and NONCLINICAL with clinicalReason no. 'my mother had covid and so did I' stays CLINICAL.
findings.expected: A self-attributed clinical mention is never resolved by the answer; a contradiction between the text and the answer is ASK.
findings.minimalCorrection: Add elliptical self-inclusion markers ('me too', 'I did too', 'so did I', 'eu tambem', 'yo tambien', 'a mi tambien' and equivalents) to the closed lexicon: in a clause following a third-party clinical clause they attribute that mention to the athlete; directed tests in the three languages.

findings.title: Pre-existing lexicon misses (not introduced by the candidate)
findings.item: SSCTR-V1CP-Q01 reReviewTrigger ('a missed self-attributed clinical case')
findings.scenario: p9: 'minha mae operou e eu tambem' and 'my dog bit me' are NONCLINICAL with a structured category on FREEZE-6 and on the candidate ('operou' and 'bit' are not in the lexicon).
findings.minimalCorrection: Lexicon additions with directed tests in the next lexicon revision.

findings.title: The repeated-adverse regression inside a ladder has no directed test
findings.item: SSCTR-V1CP-Q06 (transitionRule: 'the existing repeated-adverse regression applies'); I-16
findings.scenario: p12/p12d: two adverse strength sessions in one R3 week give HOLD, not REGRESS; no v1cp test reaches the regression branch.
findings.minimalCorrection: A directed test: a REGRESS on a ladder week repeats the rung and later fixed R-rungs take the regressed start.

observations.text: An R2/R3 rung falling on a consolidation week stacks the phase reduction (p1b: long run 60 -> 45, sets 3 -> 1), consistent with strengthReturnSets ('Consolidation ... reductions apply on top, in the return steps too'). Conservative; no finding.
When D49 caps R4 below the held sets, R5 combines the last set's return with a progression step (p3: 3x10 -> 4x12), consistent with D49 and the R6 regain rule. Disclose it; no finding.
R2/R3 KNOWN rows show the held load value with RIR >= 4 (for example 1x8 at RIR 4, 80 kg) and the instruction to choose by effort, never above it: consumer condition under I-13.

The window-end check reads the current eligibility flags; a current persistentPain yes routes clinical, a missing screen asks (p14). The decision asks discomfort against persistentPain only when not improved, which routes clinical anyway.

gaps: SSCTR-V1CPI-06: recovering sooner than the chosen window has no legitimate way back before the chosen end, and two lighter re-reports route an improving athlete to the clinical hold.
checkedWithoutGap: not improved at the window's end -> clinical hold -> readiness declaration (Situation 2)
NEED_REST not improved -> a declared break or a new plan
sessions waiting after the window -> the window-end check
a sport held by a declaration -> a later declaration
b6Statement.note: SSCTR-V1CPI-01 is the opposite risk (training kept while reportedly unwell), not a missing way back.

rules: SSCTR-V1CPI-04: an unreviewed, unreported ladder week is credited by the projection; the next rung, up to R4 at the held doses, is presented by date.
checkedWithoutFinding: the window's end waits for the structured check (no return by date)
reviewed ladder weeks repeat the rung when missed, partial, adverse or held by a report
the readiness restart's hold week is a hold, not a step
the speed choice is never evidence (RC-12)
calendarOnlyProgression.inherited: The same projection semantics exist for every R6 return when a week goes unreported (p10); they were accepted in R7-D. The decision's transitionRule is stricter for the ladder.

aeReview.answer: Plan adequate? The default path is unchanged and adequate; Situation 1 is not adequate where a later report or a race meets an open episode (-01, -05).
Material facts with provenance? The probes read structured facts only; every finding has a reproducible scenario.
KEEP defensible? Not for a systemic report during a local episode (-01) or an early recovery (-06).
Change necessary? Yes for -01..-07; relative to the decision's own rules as comparator.
Smallest sufficient intervention? Each correction reuses existing rules (Q05 coverage, the per-sport continuity, the R6 classes, C-Q05-3, the lower-bound reading) and adds no number.
Smaller alternatives? Disclosure alone leaves race effort in R3 and pre-race doses after the race (-05); copy alone leaves an improving athlete in a window (-06).
Priority and progression protected? Key runs are protected inside the rungs; the race and the next block are not (-05).
Evidence supports the conclusion and dose? No new dose; the rulings apply the record's sourced rules.
Uncertainty: how often reports meet open episodes and races in real use; the self-report residual of A1.
ASK, HOLD or CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED? Unchanged: warning signs and persistence route the clinical hold; nothing here assesses a person.
